record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:76 — Existing-attendee comparison is case-sensitive, so a case-variant of an existing attendee's address is inserted as a brand-new duplicate attendee.

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, uniqueGuests is computed with a case-sensitive check against existing attendees: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and guests are not normalized (no `.toLowerCase()`). This allows inserting a case-variant of an existing attendee email (e.g., `Foo@bar.com` vs `foo@bar.com`) as a new attendee via `attendees.createMany`, creating duplicates/broken behavior if the system treats emails case-insensitively.
